name: quiz-answers
description: The quiz (WM_ROM_OUT/quiz of rom.test.tsx, rom/quizFixture.ts: an empty screen, four questions: one long enough to wrap, one with accents the font drops). Two coins; player 1 answers question 1 right with B3 (frame 253: 100 plus 10 a second left); player 2 presses Start during question 2 (frame 424) and answers it right with B1 while player 1 answers wrong with B2; nobody answers question 3, which shows its answer when the time runs out; on question 4 player 2 answers wrong first and player 1 right; past the last question the level clears. Play mode gives both players' scores every frame.
